items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: But I (inaudible) Charlie Singleton, we did -- one time we did a lot of things.

ctx.x: You know, like we come by, we're gonna do something tonight. We go by and write for maybe two or three hours. And maybe next week we'll finish it up -- things like that.
But I (inaudible) Charlie Singleton, we did -- one time we did a lot of things. We did like "Ding Dong Buggy, Person To Person Blues." Thing called "All Night Long." You got a list of them there.
And we did a lot of things for King at that time.
